mechanics.claim: Serenity is a toggle: Hwei gains access to WQ/WW/WE (and Wash Brush) and exits the mood upon casting any of them.
mechanics.quote: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Hwei''' enters a serene mood, gaining access to its abilities as well as ''{{ai|Wash Brush|Hwei}}''. He will exit the mood upon casting any of them.

mechanics.claim: Casting WQ/WW/WE does not count as an ability activation for on-cast effects like Spellblade or Force Pulse's passive.
mechanics.quote: Toggled abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: Stirring Lights empowers Hwei's next 3 basic attacks or ability hits within 9 seconds, each dealing bonus magic damage and restoring mana.
mechanics.quote: surrounds himself in swirling flares that empower his next 3 [[basic attacks]] or [[champion ability|ability]] hits within 9 seconds to each deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and restore {{sti|{{as|mana}}}}.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield does not block Stirring Lights' bonus damage even when applied via an ability, which is a bug.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will not block the bonus damage even if it is applied by an ability.{{bug}}

mechanics.claim: Pool of Reflection's shield is granted at the start of the cast time and refreshes/grows every tick while allies (or Hwei) remain in the area.
mechanics.quote: creating a protective zone for 3 seconds that grants him and allied {{tip|champions}} a {{tip|shield}} at the start of the cast time and for {{fd|0.5}} seconds while within the area. The shield refreshes and increases in strength by an amount every {{rutngt|0.25}} over the duration while they remain in the area.

mechanics.claim: It takes approximately 1.5 seconds standing in the pool to reach the maximum shield strength, and the shield regenerates back to its cap if it mitigates damage.
mechanics.quote: it takes approximately {{fd|1.5}} seconds to gain the full shield.** The shield will be regenerated back to its cap if it mitigates damage.
